page.overview:
Who is Karale Sanghir?

Karale Sanghir is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah. She is also Black Ajah and member of a Heart along with Atuan Larisett and Marris Thornhill.

She is forced to swear on the Oath Rod obediance to Yukiri and the rest of the Black Ajah hunting Sisters. She is adamant that she now walks in the Light again.

After her interrogation, the hunt for the Black Ajah came to a problematic stalemate, since Karale's contact outside of her Heart was with the Rebel Aes Sedai.

Her Warder takes poison and kills himself when he is betrayed by Karale.
